section-205-1.TO: by regulations made by statutory instrument make provision that is consequential on this Act

section-205-2.TO: amend, repeal or revoke any enactment passed or made before, or in the same Session as, this Act

section-205-4.TO: — (a) make different provision for different purposes; (b) make transitional, transitory or saving provision

section-205-5.FOR: A statutory instrument containing (whether alone or with any other provision) regulations under subsection (1) which amend, repeal or revoke primary legislation
section-205-5.UNLESS: a draft of the instrument has been laid before, and approved by a resolution of, each House of Parliament

section-208-2.TO: appoint different days for different purposes or areas

section-208-6.TO: by regulations made by statutory instrument make transitional, transitory or saving provision in connection with the coming into force of any provision of this Act
